arguments.summary: An APT intrusion was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith. The host exhibited signs of a Cobalt Strike beacon via suspicious PowerShell and rundll32 execution from the Outlook process. Lateral movement attempts were observed via SMB to 10.0.3.10. The C2 communication to 198.51.100.23 was confirmed. Immediate containment actions included blocking the source IP at the firewall and executing a post-breach hardening playbook. No malicious behavior was found in correlated telemetry for 10.0.8.200 or 10.0.2.15. The incident has been contained with no further propagation observed.

timeline.description: Initial Nmap scan activity logged from 10.0.8.200 targeting 10.0.2.15. Low-severity alert generated.
Outlook.exe launched on WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) under user CORP\jsmith.
Encoded PowerShell executed as child of Outlook, indicative of phishing compromise (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe loaded unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
IDS triggered on Cobalt Strike beacon C2 traffic to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001).
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating potential credential access attempt (T1558.001).
Successful SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50, confirming lateral movement (T1021.002).
Incident formally initiated based on ongoing monitoring of APT activity in segment 10.0.8.0/24.
Firewall rule FW-RULE-0040 implemented to block IP 10.0.5.42 bi-directionally.
Ansible playbook 'hardening/windows/cobalt_strike_post_breach.yml' executed on WS-FIN-042 to remediate persistence mechanisms.

title: Suspicious PowerShell Execution from Outlook
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4688
selection:
  ParentProcessName|endswith: '\outlook.exe'
  NewProcessName|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
  CommandLine|contains: '-nop' and '-w hidden'
condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/

{
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        maldoc_family = "CobaltStrike"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 00 6D 00 65 00 74 00 61 00 64 00 61 00 74 00 61 00 } // "<metadata>"

        $c = { 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 } // XOR key pattern
    condition:
        all of ($a, $b, $c)
